newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 15.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - The Singapore bunker market was steady in thin trading as most suppliers held on their higher offers on expectations of further hikes to cargo prices. But demand was thin as shipowners held back their purchases in an effort to get the suppliers to drop their offers. 380-cst sales were seen at $106.00 per tonne and 180-cst at $109.00, suppliers said.
